intent: To demonstrate that the population of the UAE is overwhelmingly composed of expatriates rather than native citizens.

units.meaning: Expats make up 83.3% of the UAE population, the dominant share.

basis.note: Expats' population share in percent from slice-1.

accepted_routes: Expats account for 83.3% of the UAE population.
About 83% of UAE residents are expatriates.
Expatriates make up roughly five-sixths (83.3%) of the population.
The UAE population is about 83% expat.
units.visual_evidence_rule: A chart slice, bar, or callout for Expats must show 83.3% or a rounded 83% and be visually dominant.
units.temporal_anchor: The opening narration clause about the expat share, corrected to the table value.
units.reviewer_question: Should 83.3% be the required expat share rather than the narration's 85%?

units.meaning: Native citizens make up the remaining 16.7% of the UAE population.

basis.note: Native citizens' population share in percent from slice-2.

accepted_routes: Native citizens are 16.7% of the population.
About 17% of residents are native citizens.
Native Emiratis make up roughly one-sixth (16.7%) of the population.
The non-expat/native-citizen share is 16.7%.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The smaller slice/bar must be labeled Native citizens with 16.7% or a rounded 17%.
units.temporal_anchor: The contrast portion of the pie display where the non-expat category is shown.
units.reviewer_question: Must the native-citizen share be explicitly labeled, or can it remain implicit as the complement of expats?

units.meaning: Expats outnumber native citizens by roughly five to one.

basis.note: Expats' share used in the ratio numerator.
Native citizens' share used in the ratio denominator.

accepted_routes: Expats outnumber native citizens by about 5 to 1.
For every native citizen there are roughly five expats.
The expat-to-citizen ratio is about 5:1 (83.3% vs 16.7%).
Native citizens are about one-fifth as numerous as expats.
units.visual_evidence_rule: A ratio annotation or side-by-side visual must make the expat-to-citizen contrast roughly 5:1, not merely show two pie slices.
units.temporal_anchor: The 'compared to' contrast clause or the moment both expat and native-citizen values are on screen.
units.reviewer_question: Is the derived 5:1 outnumbering ratio required, or do the two shares alone satisfy the intent?

units.meaning: Expats exceed 80% and native citizens are below 20%, crossing the four-fifths threshold.
units.computation: Compare table values to thresholds: 83.3 > 80 and 16.7 < 20.
accepted_routes: More than 4 in 5 UAE residents are expats.
Expat share exceeds 80% of the population.
Native citizens are less than one-fifth of the population.
The split is over 80% expat and under 20% native citizen.
units.visual_evidence_rule: A threshold line at 80%/20% or an annotation such as 'over 80%' / 'under 20%' must be visible if this unit is conveyed.
units.temporal_anchor: The opening claim about expats dominating the population.
units.reviewer_question: Does the video need an explicit 80/20 threshold cue, or is the exact 83.3/16.7 split enough?

units.meaning: Expats and native citizens together account for 100% of the population shown, with no other category.
accepted_routes: Together the two slices total 100% of the UAE population.
Expats and native citizens are the only two groups shown in the pie.
The chart partitions the whole population into expats and native citizens.
The two categories sum to 100%.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The chart must show exactly two categories partitioning the whole, or include a 100% total label.
units.temporal_anchor: Throughout the pie display, especially when both slices are introduced.
units.reviewer_question: Must the video explicitly state the pie totals 100%/no other groups, or is a two-category pie self-evident?

optional_valid: Qualitative labels such as 'vast majority' or 'overwhelmingly expatriate' without introducing new numbers.
A visual ratio cue such as an icon array or waffle chart illustrating the approximately 5:1 expat-to-citizen contrast.
Color emphasis on the larger expat slice to reinforce the composition contrast.
unsupported_to_avoid: America's 14% expat share from the narration, because it is not in the table.
The narration's 85% expat share, because the table value is 83.3%.
Any non-UAE country comparison or ranking.
Causal claims explaining why expats dominate the UAE population.
Future projections, year labels, or absolute population counts not present in the table.
notes: The table contains only UAE expat and native-citizen shares (83.3% and 16.7%), so all numeric claims must be based on these or derived ratios/sums. The narration's 85% and America's 14% are not table-supported and should be treated as unsupported or corrected.
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
